components.name: Split-Flap Text
components.description: The system's signature. Per-character cells churn through a charset and settle. Container carries the accessible name; cells are aria-hidden.
components.html: BUI
components.css: .ds-flap { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.03em; } .ds-flap-c { display: inline-block; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2C2F34 0 calc(50% - 1px), #101113 calc(50% - 1px) calc(50% + 1px), #212327 calc(50% + 1px) 100%); color: #EDE7DB; padding: .08em .1em .12em; min-width: .74em; text-align: center; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.45); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: The status vocabulary. Live blinks its dot; past and scheduled do not. Outlined in currentColor, never filled.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4em; font: 500 .625rem/1 'Martian Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: .45em .6em; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 2px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip::before { content: ""; width: .4em; height: .4em; background: currentColor; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-chip-live { color: #D2891F; } .ds-chip-live::before { animation: ds-blip 2.4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-blip { 0%, 62%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 74%, 88% { opacity: .25; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip-live::before { animation: none; } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single page action. Amber on graphite; the arrow advances on hover.
components.html: Start a conversation
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: .75rem 1.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: #D2891F; color: #17140F; font: 600 .8125rem/1 Archivo, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #E8A63C; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-ico { width: 1.1em; height: 1.1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-ico { transform: translateX(3px); }

components.name: Board Row
components.description: A three-column data row: destination at display scale, detail as prose, status right-aligned. Collapses to a single stack below 52em.
components.html: BUILDINGHanzi Mind — a Chinese-language app.In development
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .5rem 1.5rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #D8CEB9; text-decoration: none; color: #14100C; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } @media (min-width: 52em) { .ds-row { grid-template-columns: 16rem 1fr 10rem; align-items: baseline; } .ds-status { text-align: right; } } .ds-row:hover { background: #E4DCCB; } .ds-row:hover .ds-dest { color: #85510A; } .ds-dest { font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(1.375rem, 3.2vw, 2rem); letter-spacing: -.02em; line-height: 1; } .ds-detail { color: #5E5D58; max-width: 48ch; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field on graphite. Invalid state borders in the error tone and pairs with a mono message below.
components.html: That address is missing something.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .5rem; } .ds-field label { font: 500 .625rem/1 'Martian Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #A5A29A; } .ds-field input { font: 400 .9375rem/1.5 Archivo, sans-serif; color: #EDE7DB; background: #212327; border: 1px solid #3A3D42; border-radius: 2px; padding: .75rem; width: 100%; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #4A4E55; } .ds-field input:focus { background: #2C2F34; border-color: #D2891F; outline: 2px solid #E8A63C; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field[data-invalid] input { border-color: #E0755C; } .ds-err { margin: 0; font: 500 .6875rem/1.4 'Martian Mono', monospace; color: #F0937C; }

narrative.overview: The surface is a split-flap departure board, and that is the information architecture rather than a decorative metaphor. Every item carries a status — DEPARTED for a closed chapter, IN DEVELOPMENT for work under way, SCHEDULED for a plan not yet started — so a subject with more direction than shipped output states the gap plainly instead of apologising for it. The physical model is a concourse, not a control room: the page ground is bone, warm and readable on a phone in daylight, and the graphite boards sit on it as objects with the shadow and the flap seam to prove it. Light and dark are two materials with fixed jobs, never a theme toggle. Type is mechanical rather than editorial — Archivo for anything a person wrote, Martian Mono for anything a machine printed.
keyCharacteristics: Status is the grammar, not an afterthought — every item on the board declares one
Two grounds with fixed jobs: bone is the room, graphite is the board object
Every dual-ground colour has two values, chosen for contrast rather than convenience
Mono is reserved for machine output; it is never a costume for 'technical'
The signature interaction is real split-flap mechanics, not an imitation of them

rules.name: The Two-Ground Rule
rules.body: Amber and petrol each carry two values. Amber #D2891F reaches 6.06:1 on graphite and is the only one permitted there; on bone it falls to 2.3:1 and must become amber-ink #85510A at 5.39:1. Petrol inverts the same way. Any component that can appear on both grounds declares both values.

rules.name: Focus Follows the Surface
rules.body: A --focus custom property resolves to amber-ink at :root and amber-hi on every dark region, so the focus ring never disappears into its own background.

rules.name: Machine Output Is Mono
rules.body: Times, dates, statuses, employers, column headers and captions are Martian Mono. Prose is Archivo. If a person wrote it, it is not mono.

rules.name: Images Do Not Set Height
rules.body: The hero portrait is absolutely positioned inside a flex-basis-zero picture so the copy column governs the board's height. Left to its intrinsic 1:2 aspect it drags the hero past the fold.

rules.name: Headers Need Their Columns
rules.body: Column headers are display:none below the breakpoint where the columns exist. Labels for collapsed columns are noise, not structure.

rules.name: Only Confirmed Facts
rules.body: Nothing appears on this page that PRODUCT.md does not record as confirmed. The board's credibility rests entirely on its statuses being true.

dos: Do give every new item a status — an item with no status does not belong on this board
Do pick the amber and petrol value from the ground the element sits on
Do use mono for machine output and Archivo for everything a person wrote
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion and keep text visible by default
Do draw icons as SVG at stroke-width 1.75 with square caps and miter joins
donts: Don't let an image's intrinsic aspect set a section's height
Don't show column headers for columns that have collapsed at that breakpoint
Don't state anything the product record does not confirm
Don't add card grids — the container here is the ruled row, and nested cards are always wrong
Don't use amber on the bone ground for text; it fails contrast at 2.3:1
